remarks: Private 2BR/1.5BA cottage with two levels of living located just 0.5 miles from downtown Westport. Sunny upper-level features vaulted ceilings, skylights, and an open-concept kitchen with new microwave. Two bedrooms, full bath, and attic storage complete the main level. Recently renovated lower level offers a spacious recreation/play room, half bath, in-unit washer/dryer, and ample storage. Central AC. Oil/heat, water, trash, and snow removal included in rent. Large yard. Convenient to shops, restaurants, and a short drive to train.
